title: ML-Tool-Bench: Tool-Augmented Planning for ML Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2512.00672v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The development of autonomous machine learning (ML) agents capable of end-to-end data science workflows represents a significant frontier in artificial intelligence. These agents must orchestrate complex sequences of data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter optimization, tasks that require sophisticated planning and iteration. While recent work on building ML agents has explored using large language models (LLMs) for direct code generation, tool-augmented approaches offer greater modularity and reliability. However, existing tool-use benchmarks focus primarily on task-specific tool selection or argument extraction for tool invocation, failing to evaluate the sophisticated planning capabilities required for ML Agents. In this work, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating tool-augmented ML agents using a curated set of 61 specialized tools and 15 tabular ML challenges from Kaggle. Our

translated_title: ML-Tool-Bench：面向机器学习任务的工具增强规划
translated_abstract: 能够执行端到端数据科学工作流的自主机器学习（ML）智能体的开发，代表着人工智能领域的一个重要前沿。这些智能体必须协调数据分析、特征工程、模型选择和超参数优化等复杂序列任务，这些任务需要精细的规划与迭代。虽然近期构建ML智能体的研究探索了使用大语言模型（LLM）进行直接代码生成，但工具增强的方法提供了更好的模块化与可靠性。然而，现有的工具使用基准主要关注任务特定的工具选择或工具调用的参数提取，未能评估ML智能体所需的复杂规划能力。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个全面的基准，使用精心整理的61个专用工具和来自Kaggle的15个表格ML挑战来评估工具增强的ML智能体。（原文摘要在此处截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 提出了ML-Tool-Bench基准，利用61个专用工具和15个Kaggle表格机器学习挑战，评估工具增强型ML智能体进行复杂规划的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces ML-Tool-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark using 61 specialized tools and 15 Kaggle tabular ML challenges to evaluate the sophisticated planning capabilities of tool-augmented ML agents.
